<h1 className={"openapi__heading"}>Generate Statement Export File</h1>

<MethodEndpoint method={"post"} path={"/v1/reports/statement/exports"}></MethodEndpoint>

:::caution deprecated

This endpoint has been deprecated and may be replaced or removed in future versions of the API.

:::

<b>Must use the path 'reports/operation-statement/exports'.</b> Initiate a request to retrieve a statement file. Use the generated file ID with the 'storage/:id/download' endpoint to download the statement in CSV format.
